title: Structura Reditus Research Library — Governing Reference Record
description: A governing-reference record (SR-GOV-*). Preserves canon-facing, constitutional, authority-axis, functional-source, kernel-reference, protocol, specification, publication-protocol, ingress, and language-contact references with their exact admitted burden. Governing records are not Tier-2 research objects and are not source records; a work may hold SRC-*, SR-GOV-*, and SR-OBJ-* identities independently. Authority belongs to the admitted burden described in authority_scope, never to the whole document. Once released in a library manifest a record's historical meaning is immutable; only status and superseded_by may change, and a later record must supersede it explicitly.

source_id.description: The source record carrying this work's archival identity. Must exist in registry/sources/.

version.description: Version identity exactly as the source states it (e.g. 'Architecture Freeze v1.0', 'UMCP-KERNEL-SPEC.v2.4.0-rc2', 'release line v2.1.5').

status.description: candidate: repair or adoption candidate, not active authority; unresolved: role, version, DOI, or adoption status ambiguous in the sources; superseded: replaced by a later record named in superseded_by.

authority_scope.description: The exact admitted burden at each authority level. Both arrays are required; either may be empty. A document is never classified wholly Tier-1 or Tier-0 because it contains material at that level.

source_role.description: The role the source itself declares or the handoff manifest admits for it.

immutable_record.description: Released governing records are never edited in place except for status and superseded_by.

active_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (explicit time zone) from which this record is in force in the library.

supersedes.description: Governing record this one explicitly supersedes; the old record is preserved.

doi.description: DOI only when the supplied source establishes it; null preserves missingness.

scope.description: What the record governs, in the source's own terms.

non_goal.description: What the source states it does not do.
